title: Company Name Change
intro: We handle your complete company name change process, ensuring all legal filings and updates are managed seamlessly for a smooth transition.
includes: Completion of NM01 form and filing
Collecting minutes from directors for name change
Name change resolution signed from shareholders
Digital copy of the name change certificate
body: At Brixen Consultants, our team of professionals can help you change your company name with ease.We complete all the formalities and paper works with Companies House and HMRC to get your company name changed within 24-72 hrs. depending on companies house workload.
**Why should you change the name of your company?**

Sometimes, you may feel that the name of your company is not working well with the nature of your business or you may feel the need to change the name of your company in order to keep your organization away from negative associations. In such a situation, you can go for changing the name of your organization which will go well with your future plans. Choosing an alternative may seem an easy job to perform, but the process is not that simple. The legal procedure of changing the name of the organization is a tiresome job.

list.title: How it works?
items: Enter all the important details in the form, pay, and then checkout.
You receive digital documents from our end in just 48hrs. by email that includes special resolution and meeting minutes.
You need to sign that document and post a resolution to Companies House.
We will process your request for name change which gets approved in just 48 hrs.However, it may take longer depending on the workload of Companies House.
On approval of your request, you will receive a certificate of a name change by email.
